mechanisms: ActionSetExpressionIR is a bounded recursive tree with source-set, subject-term, state-predicate, union, intersection, difference, and complement nodes.
Parentheses survive normalization and control recursive parse structure; each node stores evaluated ledger-bound action IDs and is hash-covered by its containing ActionSetQueryIR.
Recursive expressions are bounded to depth 8 and 32 nodes and reject malformed parentheses, unknown branches, duplicate or out-of-source IDs, and tampered cached evaluations.
Relative reported-completion filters intersect with a parenthesized subject union without turning a status question into a new language report.
Korean report particles and conjugations remain grammatical surfaces rather than being fuzzily rewritten into the report-document noun.
The original query surface supplies grouping and operators while independently resolved discourse membership supplies the source action set.
residual_limits: This remains bounded deterministic language engineering and does not establish GPT-level open-domain language competence.
The recursive grammar is limited to depth 8, 32 nodes, controlled Korean and English operator surfaces, ledger subjects, and the existing action-state predicate catalog.
Arbitrary relational subqueries, unrestricted nested relative clauses, and open-domain property composition are not implemented.
Explicit discourse-group membership revision, nested composite-group identity, and unrestricted group ellipsis remain open.
Natural realization remains less varied than a generative language model even though its factual and execution claims remain evidence-bound.
